item.title: Reports say Ralph Thorne resigns as DLP president
item.description: There are reports reaching The Nation that Ralph Thorne has resigned as president of the Democratic Labour Party. Thorne crossed the floor from the Barbados Labour Party in February 2024 to become Leader of the Opposition. He led the party into last month’s General Election where they failed to win a single seat.
